title: Team Spleefed

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Hello,

If we were to punish 'Team Spleefing' we would need solid video evidence, not screenshots as it could simply be by accident, for example: you're bridging and you suddenly stop to break the block in front without knowing a player was behind you, someone behind was running up and falls into the void.' That would still show up as 'Team Spleefing' in chat.

Thanks for your concern,
-Blizz <3
